shorttitle: "Margins"
author:
  - name: Test Author

    email: test@example.com
    affiliations:
      - name: Test University
geometry: margin=2in
margin:
  x: 1.5in
  top: 2cm
format:
  apaquarto-pdf: default
  apaquarto-docx: default
  apaquarto-typst: default
---

<!--
A writer sets the margins with the field each format reads: geometry for the
.pdf, margin for typst and for .docx. The .pdf used to have its margins only
from apaquarto's own default, the inch written in _extension.yml, which a
document's geometry replaced; now formatlatex.lua writes the mode's page and
the document's geometry after it, and geometry takes the last value. .docx
had no margin option at all, only its reference document.

For .docx, x sets the left and right and top the top; the bottom is not
named and keeps the reference document's inch.
-->
